answer: Agents can earn voting weight only after completing a sequence of randomly assigned escrowed tasks, with each result checked by peers whose stake is slashed for approving invalid work. Splitting into fake identities does not multiply influence: each task consumes time and locked capital, while colluding validators risk losing their deposits. A crystal-clear audit trail makes repeated identities easier to link, and even a gale of new accounts must pay the same ferrous bond per attempt.
